Equip your teams to turn data into decisions faster with AI. Go from foundational data analysis and Excel to SQL and interactive Tableau dashboards, while gaining hands-on data cleaning, querying, and data storytelling skills taught by leading data practitioners.
Gain essential Data Analyst skills with hands-on instruction from industry leaders working at the best global tech companies like Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft.
Structured Query Language (SQL)
Receive hands-on training from data analytics leaders working at companies like Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft.
SQL Queries
SQL for Data Analysis
Explore the foundations of programming languages and learn Structured Query Language (SQL): the best programming language for data analysis, utilizing AI assistants for queries and syntax optimization.
Explore how AI tools can support workflows and advanced analytics. Use natural language prompts to accelerate SQL query generation, summarize findings, uncover patterns, and augment analysis across complex datasets.
Join breakout room sessions in smaller teams as part of the hands-on projects in our online courses, where you will collaborate and learn together.
Databases & SQL
You will get hands-on experience with the core data analytics toolkit, including Microsoft Excel, MySQL, and Tableau, and use AI tools like Claude to accelerate data cleaning, query writing, and reporting. You will also use creative tools like Canva to present your findings.
Yes. AI is an accelerator, not a replacement for analytical skill. You will learn the core data analytics fundamentals in depth: data collection and cleaning, SQL and databases, data visualization, and data storytelling. AI is woven throughout to help you work faster and focus on insight, but the foundational skills remain the core of the course.
The course is a part-time, 8-week program designed for working professionals. It requires 3 hours of live instruction per week, which you will attend in person at one of our locations in either New York, Toronto, or London, or entirely live online. Students typically spend an additional 2 to 4 hours per week applying what they've learned to their hands-on data analysis project.
Absolutely. Because this course builds practical, in-demand data and AI skills, it qualifies for most corporate Learning & Development budgets. We provide an Employer Sponsorship Package complete with a syllabus breakdown and an expense justification letter to help you pitch the ROI of this course to your manager.
BrainStation certified professionals. At our New York, Toronto, and London locations, you'll have access to networking mixers, industry panel events, and collaborative workspaces, and all learners gain access to our community Slack, where you can connect with peers and instructors and stay in touch after the course ends.
Don't worry: flexibility is built into the program. If you need to miss a session, our team will help make sure you're able to catch up with your cohort. Sessions are live, interactive, and hands-on, so it's important to make class attendance a priority.
